notes: Item Tracker alpha preview, fourth build. Unsigned, opt-in, and may change incompatibly between previews. Works with OCRX engine v2.1.1 or later. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 include. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.9.0.
changes: Changed: Locations shows one place at a time, picked from a list grouped by system, and opens where you last were. A station the game gave a new id is no longer listed twice.
